ops.text: Use pnpm in this repo; never run npm install and delete any package-lock.json.
Store all monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats; convert with toCents and format with formatCents from src/lib/money.ts.
Do not add UI libraries such as headlessui; build UI with the existing components in src/ui (Select, Dialog, Button).
Set `draft: true` in the frontmatter of every new post until the user reviews it.
Place post images in public/images/<post-slug>/ and save them as .webp, never under src/assets.
Place unit test files next to the source file they test, e.g. src/domain/budget.test.ts; never create a __tests__ folder.
Never hand-edit files in src/api/generated; add endpoints to openapi.yaml and regenerate them with `pnpm gen:api`.
Use npm for all package installs in this project (package-lock.json is present); never run pnpm or create pnpm-lock.yaml.
Keep business logic out of components: put calculations in src/domain and expose them to components through hooks in src/hooks.
Store dates in UTC and format or compare them through src/lib/dates.ts (date-fns-tz, user timezone); never compare raw local new Date() values.
Write all UI copy in British English (colour, categorise, organisation); this is a UK product.
Default currency is GBP, not USD; use GBP as the default for any new money-related setting or display.
Never use emojis in post content, including headings; keep headings plain text.
Before saying any task is done, run `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` and fix failures; CI runs lint too, so a passing typecheck alone is not enough.
Never commit or push changes; leave all work uncommitted in the working tree so the user can review the diff.
Store all monetary amounts as integer cents, never floats; never use toFixed or *100 / Math.round math on amounts; use toCents and formatCents from src/lib/money.ts.
